hypothesis: Building on c007 (timing-driven net weighting enabled, +0.423), the partitioner currently only balances total area; extending `_refine_partition_by_area`'s tolerance to 0.20 (c008) helped ariane but hurt the others because it lets the refinement stop early. Instead, keep area_balance_error at the baseline 0.10 (c008's loosening was the regression source) and additionally let the refinement *overshoot* balance only when it reduces the number of macros moved — i.e. tighten the loop by preferring the single largest-area swap that lands within tolerance rather than the first improving one. This reduces needless macro flips that scatter critical macros across tiers, keeping timing-driven placement's critical nets short.
